from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import json, pathlib

url = "file://" + str(pathlib.Path("preview.html").resolve())

with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
    pg = b.new_page(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 900})
    logs = []
    pg.on("console", lambda m: logs.append((m.type, m.text)))
    pg.on("pageerror", lambda e: logs.append(("pageerror", str(e))))
    pg.goto(url)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(600)

    print("data-mode:", pg.evaluate("document.body.dataset.mode"))
    print("title:", pg.title())
    print("visible sections:", pg.eval_on_selector_all("[data-panel]", "els=>els.filter(e=>!e.hidden).map(e=>e.id)"))
    print("pill box:", pg.eval_on_selector("#rail-pill", "e=>{const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return [r.x|0,r.y|0,r.width|0,r.height|0]}"))
    print("api:", pg.evaluate("Object.keys(window.Preview)"))
    pg.screenshot(path="/tmp/sci.png", full_page=True)

    # click graph tab
    pg.click("#tab-graph")
    pg.wait_for_timeout(500)
    print("after click:", pg.evaluate("[document.body.dataset.mode, document.querySelector('#mode-label').textContent, document.querySelector('#panel').getAttribute('aria-labelledby'), document.querySelector('#status').textContent]"))
    print("visible:", pg.eval_on_selector_all("[data-panel]", "els=>els.filter(e=>!e.hidden).map(e=>e.id)"))
    print("accent:", pg.evaluate("getComputedStyle(document.body).getPropertyValue('--accent')"))
    print("pill box graph:", pg.eval_on_selector("#rail-pill", "e=>{const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return [r.x|0,r.y|0,r.width|0,r.height|0]}"))
    pg.screenshot(path="/tmp/graph.png", full_page=True)

    # keyboard roving: focus graph tab then ArrowDown -> date
    pg.focus("#tab-graph")
    pg.keyboard.press("ArrowDown")
    pg.wait_for_timeout(350)
    print("after ArrowDown:", pg.evaluate("[document.body.dataset.mode, document.activeElement.id, document.querySelector('#status').textContent]"))
    pg.keyboard.press("ArrowDown")
    pg.wait_for_timeout(350)
    print("wrap:", pg.evaluate("[document.body.dataset.mode, document.activeElement.id]"))
    pg.keyboard.press("Home")
    pg.wait_for_timeout(350)
    print("home:", pg.evaluate("[document.body.dataset.mode, document.activeElement.id]"))
    print("tabindexes:", pg.eval_on_selector_all("[role=tab]", "els=>els.map(e=>[e.id,e.tabIndex,e.getAttribute('aria-selected')])"))
    pg.screenshot(path="/tmp/date.png", full_page=True)

    # Preview API
    print("api setMode:", pg.evaluate("window.Preview.setMode('graph'); window.Preview.mode"))
    pg.evaluate("window.Preview.announce('hello')")
    print("announce:", pg.text_content("#status"))

    # focus ring visibility check
    pg.evaluate("window.Preview.setMode('date')")
    pg.focus("#tab-date")
    pg.keyboard.press("Shift+Tab"); pg.keyboard.press("Tab")
    print("outline:", pg.eval_on_selector("#tab-date", "e=>getComputedStyle(e).outlineColor + ' ' + getComputedStyle(e).outlineWidth"))

    # mobile
    pg.set_viewport_size({"width": 390, "height": 844})
    pg.wait_for_timeout(400)
    print("mobile pill:", pg.eval_on_selector("#rail-pill", "e=>{const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return [r.x|0,r.y|0,r.width|0,r.height|0]}"))
    print("hscroll:", pg.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth + '/' + window.innerWidth"))
    pg.screenshot(path="/tmp/mobile.png", full_page=True)

    print("logs:", logs)
    b.close()

arguments.content:
# Signum preview — handoff notes (task 1: design system, shell, mode switcher)

All work lives in a single file: `preview.html` (inline `<style>`, one inline classic `<script>`,
no deps / no CDN / no imports). It must keep working when opened via `file://`.

## Mode identity contract (do not break)
- `body[data-mode="scientific|graph|date"]` drives every per-mode accent.
- Tokens on `:root` + per-mode overrides: `--accent`, `--accent-tint`, `--accent-edge`,
  `--accent-glow`, `--on-accent` (text colour used on top of an accent fill).
- Base tokens: `--ink #0a0f0f`, `--panel #0f1615`, `--bone #f0eadd`, `--dim #9aa5a1`,
  `--rule`, `--rule-soft`, `--cyan #4fd1d9`, `--amber #f2b457`, `--violet #b79bf6`.
  (Only addition beyond the agreed contract is `--dim`; noted in a CSS comment.)
- Fonts: `--font-display` (system serif, headings + prose) and `--font-mono`
  (all figures, `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`). Do not add a third family.

## Where to build
- Panels: `<!-- ==== PANEL: scientific ==== -->`, `graph`, `date` inside `<main id="panel">`.
  Each currently holds `.panel > .panel__head + .placeholder`; replace only the placeholder.
- Logic: `// ==== LOGIC: scientific ====`, `// ==== LOGIC: graph ====`, `// ==== LOGIC: date ====`
  inside the script, before the `SHELL` block. Keep them as `//` line comments.
- Shell API already available: `window.Preview = { mode (getter), setMode(mode), announce(text) }`.
  `setMode` swaps `body[data-mode]`, `aria-selected`, roving `tabindex`, the visible section,
  `#mode-label`, `#mode-glyph`, the header blurb (`#mode-blurb`) and the rail marker.
  Call `window.Preview.announce('...')` after any calculation; it writes `#status`
  (`role="status" aria-live="polite"`). Mode switches already announce themselves.
- Local state: `current` (the active mode string). Sections carry `data-panel="<mode>"`.

## CSS primitives ready for reuse
`.panel .panel__head .cols (.cols--wide) .stack .row .readout__value .readout__label
.key .key--op .key--equals .keypad .btn .btn--primary .field .input .select .chip
.chip--accent .plot .data (dl/dt/dd, and .data--rows) .placeholder .sr-only`

## Things already solved — don't redo
- Tablist is vertical on wide screens, horizontal below 820px; `#rail-pill` is absolutely
  positioned inside `.tablist` and is re-measured by `placePill()` on mode change/resize.
  If you change rail padding or tab heights, nothing needs updating (offsets are measured).
- Keyboard: ArrowUp/Down/Left/Right + Home/End with roving focus, automatic activation.
- `prefers-reduced-motion` kills all transitions.
- Contrast verified: bone/dim/text on ink and panel >= 7:1; accents on panel >= 7.8:1;
  ink-on-accent key fills >= 8.5:1.

The whole pad answers to your keyboard: digits, + - * / ^ %, brackets, and function names typed straight in.
